classification.difficultyReason: Coordinate four exponential curves on shared axes using reflections in both axes.

content.prompt: Sketch the four graphs below on one set of axes.

answer.worked: Plot $(-1,\frac12),(0,1),(1,2)$ and draw the positive increasing exponential with asymptote $y=0$.
Reflect $y=2^x$ in the $x$-axis: $(-1,-\frac12),(0,-1),(1,-2)$. The asymptote remains $y=0$.
Reflect $y=2^x$ in the $y$-axis: $(-1,2),(0,1),(1,\frac12)$. The asymptote remains $y=0$.
Reflect $y=2^{-x}$ in the $x$-axis: $(-1,-2),(0,-1),(1,-\frac12)$. Draw all four curves on the same axes, each approaching $y=0$.

spec.description: Four exponential curves on one shared set of axes, paired by reflections.
spec.mathematics: y=±2^x and y=±2^{-x}; intercepts (0,±1), common horizontal asymptote y=0.
